signals.topic: Evening wind-down and better-sleep wellness rituals
signals.summary: A surge of interest in optimizing sleep through calming evening routines — bedtime yoga flows, legs-up-the-wall poses, tai chi and general sleep hygiene rather than pills.
signals.why_now: Producible origination in evergreen wellness video: Yoga With Adriene 'Legs Up The Wall for Better Sleep' and 'Sleep Better Tonight | 10-Minute Bedtime Flow'. Confirmed as a live wave by many independent, very recent news items: wearable REM patch (4.7h), melatonin myths (5.3h), teen weekend sleep (15.6h), sleep boosts academic performance (26.2h, 122.0h), 'Can Tai Chi Really Help You Sleep' (79.7h), heat-driven sleep loss (124.4h), plus HN threads on sleep (38.9h, 87.8h). Note: reddit returned 0 this run and much of the volume is medical-adjacent news (used only to confirm), so velocity is soft and this is framed narrowly around the producible ritual angle, not medical claims.
